parameters.query:
with periodo as (
  select generate_series($2::date, $3::date, interval '1 month')::date as mes_ref
),
meses as (
  select extract(year from mes_ref)::int as ano,
         extract(month from mes_ref)::int - 1 as mes_idx
  from periodo
),
planejado as (
  select b.category_id, sum(b.planned_value) as planejado
  from public.budgets b
  join meses m on b.year = m.ano and b.month = m.mes_idx
  where b.owner_id = $1::uuid
  group by b.category_id
),
realizado as (
  select t.category_id, sum(t.value) as realizado
  from public.transactions t
  where t.owner_id = $1::uuid
    and t.date >= $2::date
    and t.date <= $3::date
  group by t.category_id
)
select
  coalesce(p.category_id, r.category_id) as category_id,
  coalesce(p.planejado, 0) as planejado,
  coalesce(r.realizado, 0) as realizado
from planejado p
full outer join realizado r on p.category_id = r.category_id
order by category_id;

select date, category_id, description, value
from public.transactions
where owner_id = $1::uuid
  and date >= $2::date
  and date <= $3::date
order by date desc;
